questions.q: When is the box office inbox checked?
questions.gold: Tuesday to Sunday at 10 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. Eastern

questions.q: A patron asks you to hold 6 seats for one performance. May you do it yourself?
Held tickets (not a school group) are paid exactly 72 hours before curtain. Are they kept?
A patron requests a refund exactly 7 days before the performance. Is it allowed?
A latecomer arrives at a 100-minute performance. May the usher seat them at the first scene change?
questions.gold: No (only for performances up to 90 minutes; otherwise at intermission)

questions.q: A patron feels unwell. What do you tell the usher, and what do you do yourself, in what order?
questions.gold: Tell the usher to bring them to the lobby; call Ben Adeyemi at (614) 555-0176 yourself; then email Renée

questions.q: May Gordon Faulk be contacted about a ticketing problem?
Is sending Renée the sales report at exactly 4 p.m. on Monday on time?
A guest wants to book exactly 4 nights. May you confirm it yourself?
A guest will arrive at 21:30. By when must they notify, and whom do you tell to do what?
questions.gold: By 12:00 noon on the arrival day; tell the caretaker Sandro Bellini to leave the keys in the box

questions.q: A guest wants to bring a dog weighing exactly 10 kg (not a guide dog). Allowed?
Dinner for 2 adults and 2 children aged 8 and 12. What is the total?
A guest with a guide dog asks about the pet supplement. Do they pay it?
questions.gold: No; guide dogs are always free

questions.q: A guest reports a wasp sting with difficulty breathing. What do you tell them, and what do you do yourself?
questions.gold: Tell them to call 112 immediately; then call Giulia at 333 555 0184 yourself

questions.q: May the owner, Lorenzo Vitale, be copied on a guest email?
Is sending Giulia the weekend arrivals list at exactly 18:00 on Thursday on time?
A student wants a third reschedule this term. Who must approve it?
A child has attended exactly 4 lessons and the parent asks for a refund. Full refund? And who processes it?
questions.gold: Yes, full refund; Zhou Haiming in finance processes it (you just tell the parent to fill in the refund form)

questions.q: An 8-year-old whose parent signed the self-dismissal consent form wants to leave alone. Allowed?
A 7-year-old whose parent signed the self-dismissal consent form wants to leave alone. Allowed?
questions.gold: No (under 8 must be picked up by the registered parent)

questions.q: A child bleeds from the nose in class. What do you tell the teacher, and what do you do yourself, and how fast?
questions.gold: Tell the teacher to sit the child down, head not tilted back; call the front-desk first-aider at 028-5550-3196 yourself; then phone the parent within 15 minutes

questions.q: May principal Wang Lixin be cc'd on a routine parent email? And on a complaint escalation?
questions.gold: No for routine; yes for a complaint escalation

questions.q: What exact sentence must end every class reminder text?
Is sending Lin Jiayi the absence list at 17:00 sharp on Friday on time?
When is the reservations inbox checked?
A group wants 5 kayaks. May you accept the booking yourself?
A group wants 6 kayaks. Who must approve it?
A kayak is returned at 19:40. What late fee is due?
Wind speed is exactly 40 km/h. Do you cancel all launches and refund in full?
A 9-year-old wants to paddle a kayak alone. Allowed?
questions.gold: No (under 10 only with an adult in a two-person kayak)

questions.q: A customer reports a capsized kayak. What do you tell them, and what do you do yourself, in what order? May you give them the lifeguard's number?
questions.gold: Tell them to stay with the kayak; call lifeguard Kamil Nowak at 604 555 017 yourself; then message Agnieszka. No, never give out the lifeguard's number

questions.q: May the owner, Ryszard Malinowski, be copied on a customer email?
